principles: Thumb-Zone First: Driver actions must be in the bottom 40% of the screen.
Status is King: Order status (Pending, Picked Up, Delivered) must be visible from 2 meters away.
Density vs. Clarity: Admin views are dense (data-rich); Driver views are sparse (focus-rich).
Tactical Contrast: Use high-contrast borders and shadows to separate layers, not just color.

usage_rules.headings: Uppercase, tracking-tight, font-bold. Use for page titles and status states.
usage_rules.body: High legibility, standard tracking. Use for addresses and customer names.
usage_rules.data: Use Mono font for Order IDs, Phone Numbers, and Timestamps.

semantic_rules: Status badges must have a 10% opacity background of the status color + solid border.
Driver App buttons must be solid colors (Primary/Success) for maximum outdoor visibility.

buttons.driver_action: h-16 text-xl font-bold uppercase tracking-wider w-full rounded-xl shadow-lg active:scale-95 transition-transform

cards.order_card: bg-card border border-border shadow-sm rounded-lg p-4 hover:border-primary/50 transition-colors
cards.stat_card: bg-card border border-border p-6 rounded-xl flex flex-col gap-2

inputs.default: h-11 bg-background border-input focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary/20 rounded-md

status_badges.base: inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium border

accessibility.contrast: Ensure 4.5:1 contrast ratio for all text.
accessibility.touch_targets: Minimum 44x44px for all mobile interactive elements.
accessibility.focus_states: Visible ring-2 ring-offset-2 ring-primary on focus.

universal_guidelines: Do not use gradients for text.
Do not center align the app container.
All interactive elements must have data-testid attributes.
Driver App: Prioritize one-handed usage (bottom navigation).
Admin Dashboard: Prioritize data density and scanability.
instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the Admin Dashboard as a desktop-first dense interface. Implement the Driver App as a mobile-first PWA with large touch targets. Use the provided image URLs for login screens and placeholders. Strictly follow the color palette for status indication.
